parameters.geometry_note: The public Part-B files provide vessel volume but not a complete wall geometry/thermal inventory. Default DisCha geometry is retained for a sensitivity diagnostic and is not a production Part-B parameterization.

interpretation.finding: The revised non-adiabatic model lowers pressure NRMSE relative to the frozen Part-B run, but the joint pass count remains 3/5 because both 2 mm low/high pressure cases retain approximately 25.3% half-time error.
interpretation.structural_implication: The remaining error is diameter/regime dependent and is not resolved by adding the consumed DisCha wall-thermal sensitivity. A nozzle/discharge-regime or Part-B geometry characterization is required before any new holdout protocol.
interpretation.claim_boundary: This post-outcome diagnostic cannot replace the frozen Part-B result, cannot support a revised external-validation claim, and cannot be used to tune a discharge coefficient or geometry to these five cases.

next_required_evidence: Freeze an untouched release campaign with measured aperture/manifold geometry, upstream pressure/temperature and a predeclared discharge-regime model before reading outcomes.
